parsed.rationale_overall: System B demonstrates stronger personalization by explicitly tying recommendations to multiple profile attributes (income, loss comfort, tax bracket, dual goals) and provides more actionable specifics including dollar amounts, account types, and 529 plan mechanics. While System A stays more tightly focused on the tech-concentration query and has cleaner factual grounding, System B's broader strategic value (529, asset location, geographic diversification) and richer profile integration give it the overall edge.
